tagline: Hosted Streamable HTTP memory for AI agents with per-user Bearer keys, secret masking, and optional AES-256-GCM Arweave anchoring.
summary: Hosted Streamable HTTP memory at https://aifa.works/api/mcp (v2.3.0, 19 tools) for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP clients. Per upstream HOSTED-POLICY.md, discovery (initialize, tools/list) is public and tools/call uses a per-user Bearer key (scoped memory-only keys supported). Includes self-service deletion with SHA-256 receipts (memory_forget, memory_forget_receipts), memory_wake_up, family_hearth, and Markdown export (memory_export). Read-only info tools keep Guard's usual handling; private memory, deletion, exports, billing, payouts, and webhooks stay on review.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed operations and the surrounding Guard policy.
Per upstream HOSTED-POLICY.md, all tools/call invocations (including memory_about, plans, and partner_kit) require a per-user Bearer key from https://aifa.works/mcp.

The hosted backend at aifa.works is closed source; upstream policy, live 19-tool schema, and conformance script are published at https://github.com/MaksimGalatin/aifa-memory-mcp (HOSTED-POLICY.md and scripts/conformance.py).

Users can self-service delete hosted semantic records anytime via memory_forget and audit SHA-256 deletion proofs via memory_forget_receipts or export Markdown via memory_export; optional L3 Arweave ciphertext uploads remain permanent on-chain (cryptographically shredded by deleting per-record keys).
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
